summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy, black, ruff and isort are not installed in the prepared venv, so the type-check gate and formatting were checked by reading only; line lengths are within 88. A non-blank-node guard raises SHACLPathError before any graph lookup, so None and plain strings are never used as wildcards.
